title: 首购客户90天毛利与获客成本
context: 电商＋财务联合分析：管理层要求以同一企业口径核对业务数据。
requirements: 按历史首次线上订单归因渠道及首购月份；只纳入截至年底有90日完整观察期客户；首购日起第0—89日的净毛利；对照该渠道该月广告支出/该月所有新客数（包括未成熟客户），求每人成熟期毛利和获客成本差额。 净毛利采用截至2025-12-31已发生退款按原订单日归属的统一口径。
commonError: 没有预算行不是0成本，不能删除同期群，也不能把成熟客户数量当获客成本分母。
executionSteps: 在完整历史中确定首购及渠道
按0至89日计算成熟客户毛利
保留有成熟客户的全部渠道月份
以全部新客分摊预算，缺失预算保留NULL
mysqlSql: WITH f AS (SELECT o.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date,order_id) rn FROM v_order_net o WHERE channel='online'), a AS (SELECT f.customer_id,f.order_date,d.day_index idx,s.source_id,SUBSTR(f.order_date,1,7) m FROM f JOIN customer_sessions s ON s.session_id=f.session_id JOIN calendar_days d ON d.day=f.order_date WHERE f.rn=1), n AS (SELECT source_id,m,COUNT(*) customers FROM a GROUP BY source_id,m), g AS (SELECT a.source_id,a.m,a.customer_id,SUM(o.net_cents-o.cost_cents) gross FROM a JOIN f o ON o.customer_id=a.customer_id JOIN calendar_days d ON d.day=o.order_date AND d.day_index BETWEEN a.idx AND a.idx+89 WHERE a.idx+89<=(SELECT day_index FROM calendar_days WHERE day='2025-12-31') GROUP BY a.source_id,a.m,a.customer_id), z AS (SELECT source_id,m,COUNT(*) mature,AVG(gross) avg_gross FROM g GROUP BY source_id,m) SELECT z.source_id,z.m cohort,z.mature,n.customers new_customers,ROUND(z.avg_gross,2) gross90_per_customer_cents,ROUND(1.0*p.spend_cents/n.customers,2) cac_cents,ROUND(z.avg_gross-1.0*p.spend_cents/n.customers,2) difference_cents FROM z JOIN n ON n.source_id=z.source_id AND n.m=z.m LEFT JOIN marketing_campaigns p ON p.source_id=z.source_id AND p.month_key=z.m ORDER BY z.source_id,z.m
